entry.title: South African ICT skills survey finds AI skills demand outpacing university and TVET pipelines
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-IITPSA ICT Skills Survey lwe-2026, olwenziwe yi-Institute of Information Technology Professionals South Africa ngokubambisana ne-Africa Analysis, olukhululwe ngomhla we-30 ku-Oktobha 2026, lufumanisa ukuba isidingo sezakhono ze-AI, iinjineli ze-AI, iinjineli zokufunda ngomatshini, iingcali ze-AI evelisayo, iinjineli ze-prompt kanye nagosa olulawula i-AI, sikhula ngesantya esigqithe amandla eyunivesithi kunye nee-TVET zoMzantsi Afrika. Malunga ne-80% yezingcali zeICT ezibuzwayo bathi i-AI sele yancitha umthwalo wabo womsebenzi, ngoxa abaphendulayo bebalula ukunqongophala kwamava omsebenzi, izithuba kuqeqesho, ukunqongophala kohlukahlukano kunye nokufuduka kweengcali ezinamava njengezizathu eziphambili zalo nqongophalo lwezakhono.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesine ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI, ukulungela komsebenzi kwabaphumelele izidanga kunye nokuqesheka; isibongozo soluphononongo lokufunda kwindawo yomsebenzi kunye nobudlelwane obomeleleyo phakathi kweembaleka kunye noonyunivesithi buqhagamshela ngqo nesithuba phakathi koko iiyunivesithi zikufundisayo noko uqoqosho lwe-AI lwaseMzantsi Afrika lukufuna ngoku.

ITWeb (IITPSA and Africa Analysis) · Industry workforce survey (IITPSA and Africa Analysis)

entry.title: Study of five African countries finds AI adoption in universities outpacing curriculum and policy change

category.term: Ghana, Rwanda, Namibia, Kenya and Zambia

entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe iprojekthi ye-RetAIn yase-Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, olupapashiweyo kwi-Frontiers in Education kwaye olubikwe yi-Ghana News Agency ngomhla we-23 ku-Oktobha 2026, lwabuza abantu abali-156 kwaye lwabamba iintlanganiso zeqela nabachaphazelekayo abali-77 kulo lonke iGhana, iRwanda, iNamibia, iKenya kunye neZambia. Lufumanisa ukuba iiyunivesithi zithathe izixhobo ze-AI ngesantya esigqithe amandla eyitshintsha ikharityhulam, uqeqesho lootitshala okanye ulawulo, kwaye malunga nesiqingatha sabaphenduliyo bakhankanya iindleko, ezifana nemali yesikolo, idatha kunye nezixhobo, njengesithintelo esikhulu, ngelixa abafazi, abafundi abakhubazekileyo, kunye nabafundi basemaphandleni, abangathathi-ntweni kunye nabafundayo ixesha elingxamisekileyo baphantsi komngcipheko omkhulu wokushiywa ngasemva.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo; iziphumo ngokwelizwe ngalinye, umgaqo-nkqubo ongaphunyezwa eRwanda, ukulibaziseka kwikharityhulam eNamibia, iinzame ezingadityanisiweyo eGhana, zibonisa izithuba zolawulo i-Wits AHEAD ezilandelelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Ghana News Agency, reporting a Frontiers in Education study by KNUST's RetAIn project · National news agency report on a peer-reviewed study

entry.title: Office for Students tells universities to bring back in-person exams to protect assessment from AI
entry.summary:
I-Office for Students yaseNgilani ibongoza iiyunivesithi ukuba ziphinde zicinge ngokubuyela kuviwo olwenziwa ngqo nolungavumeli iincwadi, uviwo lomlomo kunye nemisebenzi yezenzo, ukwenzela ukuba uvavanyo luhlale lusebenza kakuhle ngoxa ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa (i-AI) busanda ngamandla. Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ulandela uphononongo lweenyanga ezine olwenziwe nombutho i-Advance HE, olususelwa kwiingxoxo nabafundi kunye nabasebenzi abalingana ne-300 kwiziko ezingaphezulu kwe-120, lwafumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kusanda kakhulu, kwaye ezinye iindlela zovavanyo azisalungele injongo yazo. Yeyokuqala apho umlawuli achaze izenzo zamaziko ezisebenzisa i-AI ezinokubangela ukungenelela, kuquka ukunikwa isidanga esiphantsi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yokuqala ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kuquka uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo; umlawuli kazwelonke oshukumela ukusuka esilulekweni ukuya kwiziphumo ezinyanzelekileyo ngomthetho ngumqondiso wokuba ezinye iinkqubo, kuquka eyoMzantsi Afrika, zinganokuwuqwalasela ngononophelo.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Graduates' wellbeing and civic contribution should be tracked alongside pay, British Academy argues
entry.summary:
I-British Academy ithi imilinganiselo yangoku yempumelelo yabaphumelele izidanga igxila kakhulu kumvuzo wenyanga kuphela, kwaye ifuna ukuba ulungelelwaniso lwempilo nomsebenzi, impilo yexesha elide kunye nokubandakanyeka kwasentlalweni nako kulandelelwe. Ikhombisa uphononongo lurhulumente olufumene ukuba iipesenti ezingama-24 zabo baphumelele izidanga zenza umsebenzi wokuzithandela ngokusesikweni ubuncinane kanye ngenyanga, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-17 zabo bangaphumeleliyo izidanga, kwaye icebisa ukudibanisa idatha yemfundo ephakamileyo kunye needatha zempilo nolwaphulo-mthetho ukwenza umfanekiso opheleleyo ngakumbi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesine ye-Wits AHEAD igubungela isakhono nokuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga ngaphaya komsebenzi wokuqala; umfutho wombutho kazwelonke wokufuna imilinganiselo yeziphumo ebanzi uthetha ngokuthe ngqo kwindlela i-Wits AHEAD eyichaza ngayo 'impumelelo' kubafundi bayo.

British Academy, reported by Times Higher Education · National academy report

entry.title: South Africa ranks second in Africa on new Commonwealth youth AI readiness index, behind Mauritius
entry.summary:
I-2026 Commonwealth Youth AI Readiness Index, eyenziwe yi-Ayre Think Tank isuka kwimithombe engama-1 128 kuwo onke amazwe ali-56 e-Commonwealth, ibeka uMzantsi Afrika kwindawo yeshumi elinethathu jikelele enamanqaku ali-56.8 kwele-100, kwindawo yesibini eAfrika emva kweMauritius (ene-64.4, kwindawo ye-8 ihlabathini). Le ndex iqikelela ukuba i-AI inganika uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwe-US$4.7 bhiliyoni ne-US$13.7 bhiliyoni kuqoqosho lwayo ngaphakathi kweminyaka elishumi, kuxhomekeke kwimeko.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD yi-AI enoxanduva, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo; iindex zokulungela kazwelonke ezinje zibumba isizathu sepolisi sokutyala imali kubuchule be-AI nolawulo kulo lonke uMzantsi weHlabathi.

University World News (from African Insider) · Established higher education press

entry.title: Youth unemployment eases slightly to 47.3% as overall unemployment rises to 33.7% in the third quarter of 2026
entry.summary:
Izinga elisemthethweni lentswela-ngqesho linyuke ngamanqaku epesenti ali-0.1 laya kuma-33.7% kwikota yesithathu ka-2026, ngoxa uqeshwa lwanda ngabantu aba-101,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-16.8, kodwa umsebenzi usanda ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi. Intswela-ngqesho yolutsha (iminyaka 15 ukuya ku-34) yehla ngamanqaku ali-0.1 ukuya kuma-47.3%: ulutsha olungaqeshwanga lwehla nga-23,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-5.0, ngelixa ulutsha oluqeshiweyo lwehla nga-5,000 ukuya kwizigidi ezi-5.5.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Eli linani iqela elilisebenzisayo kwiindlela zabafundi abafundela ezidanga nakutshintsho olunobulungisa. Umba 4 ubuza ukuba i-AI iyasihla okanye iyasandisa esi sithuba kweli qela ngqo.

Statistics South Africa · National statistics office

entry.title: University AI policies focus on cheating but leave data risks largely unaddressed, commentary warns
entry.summary:
Impawulo ekwi-University World News ithi iiyunivesithi zibhale imithetho ecokisekileyo yokulwa ubuqhetseba olunceda yi-AI, kodwa zishiya izikhokelo ezimbalwa ngendlela abasebenzi nabaphandi abanokungenisa ngayo idatha yeziko, yabafundi okanye yophando kwizixhobo ze-AI. Ikhankanya uphononongo lwase-UK apho ama-63% awezi-49 ziko lemfundo ephakamileyo asele asebenzisa isixhobo se-AI, kodwa ama-37% kuphela aphonononge imingcipheko ngaphaya komnikezeli waso osuduze, kananjalo ikhankanya ukuvuza kwedatha e-University of Osaka okuchaphazele abantu aba-77,851 njengesikhumbuzo sokuba umngcipheko omkhulu udla ngokuba yimpazamo eqhelekileyo yedatha, hayi imodeli ye-AI ngokwayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumba 6, ngendalo ye-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, oku kukhuthaza ukuba kujongwe ukuba ulawulo lwe-AI eziyunivesithi, kubandakanya nolo lweli qela ngokwalo, lugubungela ukuphathwa kwedatha, hayi ingqibelelo yezemfundo kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary)

entry.title: Wits opens a Global Higher Education Futures Centre, with a dedicated generative AI pedagogy hub
entry.summary:
I-University of the Witwatersrand ivule ngokusesikweni i-Global Higher Education Futures Centre, eyadibanisa iinxalenye kwi-webinar yokuqala ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba eyazuza ngaphezu kwabafundisi-ntsapho, iinkokeli zeziko kunye nabenzi bomgaqo-nkqubo abangaphezu kwe-170. Iziko eli lihlelwe ngokusekelwe kwiindawo ezisithoba, enye kuzo izinikezelwe kwi-AI evelisayo yokufundisa, kwaye lichazwa njengempendulo kwinqwaba yeengxaki ezibandakanya ukutshintsha kwemozulu, umngeni kwipolitiko yamazwe ngamazwe, ukuphazamiseka kwe-AI evelisayo kunye nokungalingani kuMzantsi weHlabathi. Umsunguli weli ziko, uNjingalwazi Ruksana Osman, kunye nomlawuli, uGqirha Bernadette Johnson, bathi iziko eli liya kubeka phambili ukuveliswa kolwazi kuMzantsi weHlabathi kunokuba lithabathe iimodeli ezenziwe kuMntla weHlabathi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, iyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika iyakha olwayo uqongqo lokucinga ngokuphazamiseka kwe-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kunokuba ithabathe olwenziwe kwindawo yimbi, nto leyo ingxaki yoMzantsi weHlabathi engagqibelelekayo esekelwe kulungelelwaniso i-Wits AHEAD ikhona ukuyixhasa.

University of the Witwatersrand · University announcement

entry.title: Wording of university generative AI policies shapes how students and teachers actually behave, study finds
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bahlalutye imigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI evelisayo yaziyunivesithi ezili-101 zaseMelika, baza badlulisela kubafundi abali-20 nabasebenzi abali-20 ukuba babuzwe ngendlela imigaqo le isetyenziswa ngayo ngempela. Bafumanise ukuba ulwimi oluchanekileyo lomgaqo, kungekhona nje umxholo wawo, lutshintsha indlela abafundi abaziphatha ngayo: umgaqo ogxininisa ekungathembekini wenza abafundi bafihle ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngoloyiko, ngelixa umgaqo ogxininisa ekuziphendulisweni wakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bavakalise obala. Ootitshala, kwelinye icala, bathi bathwele umsebenzi owongezelelweyo wokuvuma, kananjalo bengenayo indlela ethembekileyo yokuqinisekisa ukuba abafundi bathobela imigaqo le.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, lo phando sikhumbuza ukuba umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI evelisayo ulungile kuphela ngokulingana nolwimi lwawo: iiyunivesithi ezibhala okanye ezihlaziya imigaqo yazo yesebenzisa i-AI kufundisa nakuvavanyo, kufuneka zivavanye ingekuphela nto umgaqo ovumela, kodwa indlela abafundi nabasebenzi abaza kufunda baze basebenze ngamagama lawo uqobo.

arXiv preprint (University of Maryland and University of Iowa researchers) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: How deeply students engage with an AI chat, not how often they use it, predicts better coursework, large Australian study finds
entry.summary:
Abaphandi be-University of Queensland kunye ne-Monash University baphonononge abafundi abali-1 681 kwiikhosi zeyunivesithi ezili-40 ababesebenzisa amaqabane e-AI abakhelweyo kwimisebenzi yokudala izixhobo, ukulamla phakathi koontanga kunye nokuziqhelanisa. Bakhodinge iintlanganisela zeencoko ezili-829 ngokubandakanyeka kwengqondo baze bamodele iintolongo zemisebenzi ezingaphantsi kwe-3 000, bafumanisa ukuba abafundi ababandakanyeka nzulu nge-AI, kunokuba baxoxe nayo rhoqo, bavelisa umsebenzi ogqibeleleyo wophuhliso olukumgangatho ophezulu, nokuba baphosene imiyalezo emingaphi. Emva kokulinga okungachanekileyo, abafundi abancokolayo kunye ne-AI benza amalinge ambalwa ngaphezulu, kodwa bade babe nokulungileyo rhoqo xa bephinda bazama.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 2, lo mfumaniso ubalulekile kuzo zonke iziko ezakha uhlalutyo malunga nokusetyenziswa kwe-AI: ukubala ukufuthi abafundi bavula ikhetshbhothi kuthetha kancinci ngokufunda, ngoko iinqubo eziyilelwe ukuxhasa impumelelo yabafundi kufuneka zijonge ubunzulu bokubandakanyeka, kungekhona ukufutha kokucofa.

University of Queensland and Monash University (arXiv preprint, submitted to the Journal of Computer Assisted Learning) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, submitted to the Journal of Computer Assisted Learning)

entry.title: Grade the process, not just the AI-era output, Bristol pro vice-chancellor tells student success conference
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwinkomfa ye-Times Higher Education ye-Student Success eyenzelwe e-United Kingdom nase-Ireland, uTansy Jessop, isekela-rektala yemfundo nabafundi e-University of Bristol, uthi iiyunivesithi zidlule kuphela ekugadeni ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwe-AI evelisayo, kufuneka ngoku ziyile uvavanyo olubonisa indlela umfundi afikelele kuyo kwimpendulo yakhe. Uchaze imeko yesayensi yekhompyuter eBristol apho izithuthi zokwakha iirobhothi zazidla ngokuba zivela kwi-AI ngokupheleleyo, nto leyo eyenza abasebenzi bagqibe ekubeni banike abafundi irobhothi egqityiweyo baze babacele ukuba baqikelele indlela eyakhiwe ngayo. UJessop uthi indlela le iya kunceda abafundi baphuhlise izakhono i-AI engenakuzitshintsha lula, ezifana nokunxanelwa kwazi, ukucinga okujulileyo kunye nentsebenziswano.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, oku kunikezela impendulo yangempela kumbuzo wengqibelelo yovavanyo: kunokuphila ngokuleqa izixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI ezingathembekiyo, kwakha imisebenzi ebonakalisa ukucinga komfundi kwaye igcine umgwebi oyintu kulo nqubo.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: AI-generated 'slop' papers published under prominent academics' names without their consent
entry.summary:
Iqela leephephandaba ezifana ngokubukeka lipapashe amaphepha aveliswe yi-AI ngamagama abaphandi abaziwayo, kubandakanya uJure Leskovec noFei-Fei Li base-Stanford, abathi abakaze babhale okanye bangenise lo msebenzi. I-Times Higher Education ixela ukuba iphepha elinye liphinde lavela ngegama lombhali owahlukileyo kwintsuku ezimbalwa emva kokuba laboniswa laza lasuswa, kwaye iiphephandaba ezi zahlukana umhleli omkhulu omnye kunye noonxibelelwane bebhodi abangazi ukuba badweliswe. Iiphephandaba ezintathu ezi, ezabhalisa kuphela ngo-2026, zibiza ababhali phakathi kwedola 10 nedola 200 kwiphepha ngalinye.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 6, lo mcimbi ubonisa indlela i-AI evelisayo enganokusetyenziswa ngayo ukwenza amaxoki ongekuko kuphela kwiziphumo zophando, kodwa nobunikazi lwabo babaphandi, kungoko umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI enoxanduva kwimfundo ephakamileyo ufanele usonwabise ukunyaniseka kukupapashwa, ingagcini kwigumbi lokufunda.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Staff overestimate how much students use generative AI, Manchester study finds
entry.summary:
Uphando olwenziwe kwisikolo esinye sesayensi yoluntu kwiyunivesithi yase United Kingdom lufumanise ukuba abafundisi-ntsapho babukeza ngokugqithisileyo indlela abafundi abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI evelisayo kwizifundo zabo. Ngokusekelwe kwimibuzo eyenziwa kubafundisi-ntsapho abangama-45 nabafundi abangama-86 kwi-University of Manchester, abafundisi-ntsapho babukeza ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngabafundi ku-5.23 kwisikali esinamanqaku asixhenxe, okuphezulu kakhulu kunomyinge wabafundi ngokwabo ongu-3.11. Abafundi babonakala banethemba ngakumbi kunabafundisi-ntsapho ngokuphathelele iingenelo ze-AI kwimveliso nokufunda, bathi bayisebenzisa ikakhulu ukufumana impendulo, ukulungiselela umsebenzi obhaliweyo nokulungisa igrama.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 1, umahluko phakathi koko abafundisi-ntsapho bakubukezayo noko abafundi bakwenzayo ngenyaniso ubonisa isizathu sokuba umgaqo-nkqubo wokusetyenziswa kwe-AI evelisayo kunye nokuyilwa kokufundisa kufuneka kuxhomekeke kubungqina obuvela kubafundi ngokwabo, hayi kwimbono yabafundisi-ntsapho, ngokukhethekileyo ngoxa iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi weHlabathi zicamngca ngezicamango ezifanayo.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Habit, not enjoyment, drives ChatGPT use among distance students at the University of South Africa, study of 294 finds
entry.summary:
Uphando olwenziwe kubafundi abangama-294 be-University of South Africa, elona ziko likhulu lemfundo esemgama e-Afrika, lusebenzise imodeli ye-UTAUT2 ukuphonononga ukuba kutheni abafundi besebenzisa i-ChatGPT. Umkhwa yayiyeyona nto yomeleleyo eqikelela zombini injongo yokusebenzisa i-ChatGPT nokuyisebenzisa ngokwenene, ilandelwa ziimeko ezincedisayo ezinjengesikhokelo nezixhobo, ngelixa ukonwaba nezimvo zoontanga zingabanga nampembelelo ibalulekileyo. Imodeli ichaza iipesenti ezingama-69.2 zenjongo yabafundi yokusebenzisa esi sixhobo neepesenti ezingama-37.9 zokusisebenzisa kwabo ngokwenene.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 1, ukufumanisa ukuba umkhwa nenkxaso yeziko, hayi ubutsha bento, kuqhuba ukusetyenziswa kubonisa ukuba iiyunivesithi kufuneka zibumbe imikhwa yemihla ngemihla yabafundi nge-AI ngesikhokelo nangoyilo lwezifundo, ingakumbi kwimfundo esemgama kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa and Europe seek their own path on AI in science, with shared computing and genomic data on the agenda
entry.summary:
Kwintlanganiso ye-African Union ne-European Union malunga ne-AI kwisayensi ngomhla wama-26 ku-Okthobha, eyabanjwa kwi-intanethi endaweni yokuba ibe se-Addis Ababa njengoko kwakucwangcisiwe, uMaria Cristina Russo, igosa eliphezulu le-European Commission, uthe i-United States ne-China ziya phambili kakhulu kwaye i-Europe ne-Afrika zidinga indlela yazo. Izithethi zacela amandla ekhompyutha abelwanayo kwimimandla, isakhelo selizwekazi sedatha yemfuza nokwabelana ngeenzuzo, kunye neenjongo ezinokulinganiswa zabasetyhini, abamalunga nesinye kwisihlanu sabasebenzi behlabathi kwidatha nakwi-AI. Iingcebiso ziya kuthunyelwa kwintlanganiso yabaphathiswa be-AU ne-EU yophando nokuyila ehlehliselwe ku-2027, ngokutsho kwe-University World News.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 6, le ntlanganiso ibeka ubunini bedatha, ukufikelela ngokulinganayo kumandla ekhompyutha nokuhamba kwezakhono embindini womgaqo-nkqubo we-AI, imibuzo eya kugqiba ukuba iiyunivesithi zase-Afrika ziya kuyibumba na i-AI kuphando okanye ziya kuyisebenzisa nje kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: UNESCO: university enrolment in the Arab States has nearly tripled to almost 15 million, yet youth unemployment stands at 26%
entry.summary:
Ingxelo entsha ye-UNESCO, i-The state of higher education in the Arab States, ifumanisa ukuba inani labafundi abangena kwiiyunivesithi kulo mmandla liphantse laphindeka kathathu kwiminyaka engama-25, lafikelela phantse kwizigidi ezili-15 zabafundi, nangona izinga lobhaliso, eliziipesenti ezingama-37 ngo-2024, lisengaphantsi komndilili wehlabathi oziipesenti ezingama-44. Abasetyhini ngoku baphantse babe sisiqingatha sabaphumelele izidanga ze-STEM kulo mmandla, xa kuthelekiswa nesahlulo esingaphezulu kancinci kwesinye kwisithathu ehlabathini, kodwa ukungaqeshwa kolutsha kumi kwiipesenti ezingama-26, phantse kabini umndilili wehlabathi. Le ngxelo, eyasungulwa eDoha ngomhla we-4 kuNovemba, inika iingcebiso ezilishumi kwaye iphawula ukuba ngaphezulu kweepesenti ezingama-70 zamazwe ama-Arab ngoku afaka iinjongo zedijithali kwizicwangciso zawo zesizwe zemfundo ephakamileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 5, oku kubonisa oko idatha yommandla ngemfundo ephakamileyo enokukutyhila: ukwanda okukhulu kokufikelela akuthethi nto ingako ukuba iinkqubo azilandeli ukuba abaphumelele izidanga bayawufumana na umsebenzi, uvavanyo olufanayo uMzantsi Afrika noMzantsi weHlabathi ojongene nalo.

UNESCO (IESALC and UNESCO Office Beirut) · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Deep Learning Indaba video: Vukosi Marivate on governing AI in Africa and what a degree is worth now
entry.summary:
Kudliwanondlebe lwemizuzu engama-36 olwarekhodwa ngexesha le-Deep Learning Indaba 2026 kwi-Pan-Atlantic University eLagos, uNjingalwazi Vukosi Marivate, omnye wabaseki be-Indaba, i-Masakhane NLP ne-Lelapa AI, nomnye weengcali ezingama-40 kwi-United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, ucacisa ukuba kuthetha ntoni ukucebisa oorhulumente nge-AI nokuba kutheni ulawulo lwe-AI eMzantsi Afrika luchaphazela onke amasebe karhulumente. Uthi ukuzimela kuthetha amandla okuzenzela izigqibo, hayi ukwakha yonke into ekhaya, ukuba i-AI ayiluphulanga uvavanyo kodwa iveze ubuthathaka balo, nokuba i-Afrika kufuneka isuke ekumkeni kweengcali iye ekujikelezeni kweengcali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika 4, imibuzo yakhe malunga nexabiso lesidanga kwixesha le-AI, nokuba ingaba i-Afrika iqeqesha abasebenzi be-AI abangabizi ukuze basebenzele amanye amazwe, ichukumisa undoqo wesakhono sabaphumelele izidanga notshintsho olunobulungisa kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Deep Learning Indaba (YouTube) · Africa's machine learning community, official video channel

entry.title: South Korea vows to prosecute students using AI glasses in exams
entry.summary:
ISebe lezeMfundo laseMzantsi Korea lithi, ukusukela kunyaka ozayo, liya kuphatha ukuqhatha kuviwo lwesizwe lokungena eyunivesithi ngokusebenzisa iindondo ezihlakaniphileyo ze-AI njengetyala lobugebenga, emva kokuba abafundi abathathu babanjwa benxiba ezi zixhobo ngethuba lovavanyo lokubhala eziyunivesithi zaseSeoul. Ukusukela ngo-2027, abo babanjwa baya kuvinjelwa kuviwo iminyaka emithathu, endaweni yonyaka omnye, kwaye abahloli baya kubekwa kuzo zonke izikhungo zovavanyo ezingama-1 312 ukujonga iindondo ezirhanelekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Luphawu olucacileyo lwendlela izixhobo ze-AI evelisayo ezigqitha ngayo ngokukhawuleza imithetho yengqibelelo yovavanyo ehlabathini (intsika 1), kunye nesikhumbuzo sokuba ukubona kunye nesohlwayo yinxalenye kuphela yempendulo eziyunivesithi kunye neenkqubo ziya kuyidinga.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI Article Reviews Dominate Human Peer Reviews at Their Best: Evidence and Policy Choices
entry.summary:
UGary King noSteven Worthington bokwiHarvard Institute for Quantitative Social Science bathelekise uphononongo lwabangqina (peer review) olubhalwe yi-AI noluphononongo lwabantu olungu-134 kuma-manuscript angu-124 aqokelelwe phakathi ko-2019 no-2026. Babika ukuba uphononongo olwenziwe yi-Claude Opus 4.8 lwadlula uphononongo lwabantu kuzo zonke iinqanaba abalwakhayo, lwagwetywa ngokuba luchanekile ngakumbi kuvavanyo lwabo, kwaye lukhethwe ngabahleli bamajenali abathathu abadala kolukhulu uphononongo lokuthelekiswa olubhekisa ngqo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Umceli mngeni ocingisisiweyo osekelwe kwidata ngendlela i-AI evelisayo esetyenziswa ngayo kwisenzo semfundo ephakamileyo, ingaphelelanga kwigumbi lokufundisa kuphela (intsika 1): ukuba i-AI inakho ukuphonononga uphando kakuhle, iiyunivesithi namajenali afuna umgaqo-nkqubo wokuba usetyenziswa njani kwaye nini, ingekuko nje ukuba uvalwe.

Institute for Quantitative Social Science, Harvard University · University working paper

entry.title: Proposal 14: Student outcomes indicators
entry.summary:
Umlawuli wemfundo ephakamileyo yaseNgilane, i-Office for Students, ucebisa ukutshintsha umda wawonke-wonke wokuphumelela kwabafundi abaphumelele izidanga, ngokusebenzisa iinkomba ezintathu eziqhathaniswayo kwi-Teaching Excellence Framework yayo: ukuqhubeka ngomsebenzi okanye ukufunda, imali abaphumelele izidanga bayifumana xa kuthelekiswa nemigangatho yesizwe, kunye nokuba abaphumelele izidanga bathi basebenzisa oko bakufundileyo, ngokutyhila kophando lwe-Graduate Outcomes. Le migangatho izakulungelelaniswa ngokwecandelo lesifundo, indawo, iziqinisekiso zokungena, kunye neemeko zoqoqosho zabafundi, kunokusebenzisa umda omnye omiselweyo kuzo zonke izifundo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo ngumlinge wangoku kumbuzo ophambili wentsika 5: ukuba inkqubo yedata eyakhiwe ngeenkomba ezininzi eziqhathaniswayo, kunomda omnye obanzi wesizwe, inakho ukugweba ngokufanelekileyo kwaye iphucule iziphumo zemfundo ephakamileyo.

Office for Students (OfS) · National regulator consultation

entry.title: UCT engineering pairs AI-enabled early warning with a multilingual support hub to lift student success
entry.summary:
Abaphandi e-Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment kwi-University of Cape Town bachaza iProjekthi yempumelelo yabafundi edibanisa uqeqesho lokuqwalasela umngcipheko kwangethuba, ukuxhaswa koontanga kunye nendawo yenkxaso esekwe kwimininingwane kwaye esebenzisa i-AI. Indawo le ihambelana nesichazi-magama sezilwimi ezininzi esikwi-isiXhosa, iSesotho, iKiswahili kunye nesiBhulu, esijongana nokubekelwa bucala kolwimi ngaxeshanye nomngcipheko wezifundo. Isahluko sivela kuConstellations of Hope, ingxelo yeClub of Rome ephathelele kufundo oluguqula ubomi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Umzekelo waseMzantsi Afrika ongqinisekisiweyo, ophathekayo, wohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi (iNtsika 2) owakhelwe ngaphezu kolingano lwezilwimi ezininzi, ubonisa ukuba imininingwane yesilumkiso kwangethuba incede abafundi kuphela ukuba inkxaso elandelayo nayo ithetha ulwimi lwabo.

Globethics Publications (Club of Rome report) · Peer-reviewed book chapter

entry.title: AI literacy alone does not create graduate opportunity, Nigerian study of 450 students finds; technology readiness is what matters
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabafundi beyunivesithi base-Nigeria abali-450 lufumanisa ukuba imfundo yoshishino kunye nengqibelelo ye-AI zombini ziphucula ukulungela kobuxhakaxhaka kwabafundi, kwaye kukulungela oku okuchongayo ukuba ngaba abafundi baguqula izixhobo ze-AI zibe ngamashishini amancinci okwenyani. Ukunqongophala kweemfuno okuqikelelwayo kuthoba ngqo isenzo soshishino sabaphumelele izidanga, kodwa kuqinisa unxulumano phakathi kokulungela kunye nesenzo xa abafundi sele benezo zixhobo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ubungqina obungqalileyo kwiNtsika 4: ukufikelela kwi-AI kuphela akudali amathuba kubaphumelele izidanga kwiindawo eziswele izixhobo; kwakhiwa izakhono kunye nokulungela kobuxhakaxhaka okuguqula ingqibelelo ye-AI ibe yindlela yokuphila.

Journal of Entrepreneurship in Emerging Economies · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Computational text indicators fail to improve, and can worsen, predictions of academic results, Salvadoran study warns
entry.summary:
Abaphandi kwi-Universidad Salvadoreña Alberto Masferrer baphonononge ukuba ngaba izalathiso zombhalo ezivela kulwimi lobuchwepheshe lokufunda ngomatshini, ezichaza imigaqo-ndlela yokuqonda yabafundi, zinganwenwa ukuqikelela iziphumo zezifundo ngaphezu kolwazi oluqhelekileyo lwekhaya nolwezixhobo. Kubafundi abali-263 ababukelwe kabini kumaziko amahlanu, izalathiso zokubala azizange zongeze xabiso lokuqikelela olungathenjwayo, kwaye inguqulelo enye yenza ukuqikelelwa kube kubi ngokucacileyo emva kokulungelelaniswa kwiintelekelelo ezininzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Isilumkiso esicacileyo kwi-Intsika 5: izalathiso zombhalo okanye zokuziphatha eziveliswe yi-AI azifanele zithathwe njengezilungele izigqibo zemfundo ezinobungozi obukhulu ngaphandle kovavanyo olungqongqo, ingqeqesho ethathelwa yi-Wits AHEAD emsebenzini wayo wohlalutyo.

Journal of Applied Research in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: LMS activity, pacing and attendance are the strongest predictors of retention in blended courses, Turkish study finds
entry.summary:
Isifundo esikwiJournal of Higher Education Policy and Management, esenziwe ngu-İrfan Ayhan weKırşehir Ahi Evran University eTürkiye, saphononongo indlela uhlalutyo oluqikelelayo, olususelwa kumsebenzi weenkqubo zolawulo lokufunda, isantya, ukuziphatha kuvavanyo kunye nokuya esikolweni, olunokubonisa abafundi abasemngciphekweni kwizifundo ezixubeneyo kwimfundo ephakamileyo. Sifumanisa ukuba ezi zalathiso zezona zinamandla ukuqikelela ukugcinwa kwabafundi, kwaye sithi, xa lusetyenziswa kakuhle, uhlalutyo oluqikelelayo lunganika amandla iinkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye nokukhokelela kwiindlela zamaziko, ukuba amaziko nawo anikela ingqalelo kwimigaqo yokuziphatha yokusebenzisa olu lwazi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD wentsika ye-i-AI kunye nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, esi sifundo sikhumbuza ukuba idatha esele ikhona kwiinkqubo zolawulo lokufunda zamaziko amaninzi, kungekhona kuphela izixhobo ze-AI ezintsha, inganika amandla isiqalisiso sesilumkiso kwangethuba esisebenzayo xa lihambelaniswa nesakhelo esicacileyo sokuziphatha.

Journal of Higher Education Policy and Management · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Short hands-on workshop lifts science teachers' confidence in using AI for adaptive teaching, German pilot study finds
entry.summary:
Isifundo esiphononongiweyo kwijenali ethi Frontiers in Education, esenziwe ngu-Mathea Brückner, u-Christoph Thyssen kunye no-Johannes Huwer, savavanya ukuba iwekshophu emfutshane, enezandla, ingakwazi ukunyusa ukuzithemba kootitshala bezifundo zemfundo-ntsapho ekusebenziseni i-AI ekufundiseni okuguqukayo. Kuphononongo olwenziwa ngootitshala abali-16 eJalimani, ukubona kwabo ukuba i-AI iluncedo kunye nokuzithemba kwabo ekuyisebenziseni, kokubini kwanyuka ngokubalulekileyo emva kwesi sifundo. Ababhali bayalumkisa ukuba le sampulu incinane ibonisa utshintsho, kungekhona ukungqina ukuba iwekshophu yenza utshintsho oluhlala njalo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD wentsika ye-i-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwimfundo ye-STEM nemfundo yootitshala, esi sifundo sibonisa indlela encinci, engabizi kakhulu, iwekshophu emfutshane enezandla, enokusetyenziswa yinkqubo yoqeqesho lootitshala ukwakha ukuzithemba kootitshala bezifundo zemfundo-ntsapho kwii-AI.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: World Bank video: 'small AI', not big models alone, can widen opportunity in developing-economy education and jobs
entry.summary:
Kwindibano yeHlabathi malunga ne-i-AI kunye noMnxeba, eSeoul, eqhutywe yiWorld Bank Group, uMongameli wayo u-Ajay Banga wavula iqonga malunga nendlela amaxhoba e-"i-AI encinci", asebenzisekayo kwaye alungelelaniswe nemeko yasekhaya, kungekhona kuphela iimodeli ezinkulu ngokubanzi, anganika amathuba kumazwe aphuhlayo. UMphathiswa wezoNxibelelwano, uBuvelwano kunye noQoqosho olungumxholo waseNigeria, uBosun Tijani, wadibana noMphathi oyiNtloko yeTridge, uHoshik Shin, kunye nomseki we-Amini, uKate Kallot, ukuxoxa ngemfundo, ulimo kunye neenkonzo zoluntu, kunye necandelo elithetha ngezifundo ezifunyenwe ekusetyenzisweni kwe-i-AI kwimfundo eEl Salvador. Iqonga lithethe ngedatha yasekhaya ethembakeleyo, unxibelelwano olufikelelekayo, amandla okubala, izakhono kunye neendlela zokuthenga njengeemeko ezivumela abaqambi bendawo ukwandisa izisombululo zabo ze-i-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD wentsika ye-i-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, ingxoxo le ibeka ithemba le-i-AI kwiimeko ezisebenzisekayo, izakhono, uzinzo kunye nokuthenga, ezigqibayo ukuba iiyunivesithi kunye neenkqubo zamazwe aphuhlayo ziyazuza ngokwenyani, kungekhona kuphela amaqabane awo anemithombo engakumbi eMntla weHlabathi.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Review of generative AI ethics in higher education finds Africa only 11% of the evidence, calls for Ubuntu-informed governance
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo olupapashwe kwijenali ethi Education Sciences, ngu-Pearl Yarkor Yarboi kunye nabasebenzi abangabalingane be-University of Ghana, luhlole izifundo 246 ezapapashwa phakathi kuka-2018 no-2025 malunga nemigaqo yokuziphatha ye-i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, kwaye lufumanise ukuba amaziko aseAfrika amele ngasiphakathi iipesenti 11.4 kuphela kwaloo mbhalo, kwaye amaziko aseGhana amele iipesenti 2.8 kuphela. Luhlanganisa iinkxalabo eziphindaphindekayo kumacandelo amahlanu, ingqibelelo yezemfundo, ubumfihlo kunye nokhuseleko lwedatha, ukucaca kunye noxanduva, ulingano kunye nokufikelela, kunye noluvo ngenye icala lwe-i-AI, kwaye luxela ukuba amaziko aseGhana ngokukodwa abonakalisa ulawulo oluphantsi olucwangcisiweyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, isicelo soluphononongo lwezakhelo zemigaqo yokuziphatha ezihambelana nemeko kwaye ezisekwe ku-Ubuntu, kunokuba ngamanye amazwe aphuma kuMntla weHlabathi, athetha ngqo nendlela yeqela ngqo malunga ne-i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo yaseAfrika.

Education Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 50 studies finds university AI governance works best when oversight, integrity rules and data risk are managed together
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo olupapashwe kwijenali ethi Frontiers in Education, olukhokelwa ngu-Fritz D. Bacalso kunye nabasebenzi abangabalingane be-Cebu Technological University ePhilippines, luhlole iirekhodi 201 ngokulandela inqubo ye-PRISMA 2020 kwaye luhlanganise izifundo 50 malunga nendlela amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo alawula ngayo i-AI evelisayo. Lufumanise ukuba ukwamkelwa okuphumelelayo kuxhomekeke ekuvuthweni kolawulo: ulawulo oluququzelelweyo phakathi kwamacandelo eeyunivesithi, imigaqo ecacileyo yengqibelelo yezemfundo kunye nokutyhila, kunye nolawulo lwedatha olusekelwe kumngcipheko, kunye neenzuzo zokusebenza kakuhle kunye nokufunda xa inkxaso yezemfundo ihamba kunye nobuchwepheshe. Uphononongo luphinda lubike umsantsa omkhulu phakathi kweziphaluka, lucaphula isifundo esinye apho iiyunivesithi ezintandathu zoMzantsi Afrika zineemigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI ezisemthethweni, ngelixa akukho namaziko asampula eGhana okanye eNigeria aneendlela zolawulo ezifikelelekayo luluntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-i-AI evelisayo kufundiso, kuvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, lobu bungqina bokuba ukuvuthwa kolawulo, kungekhona ukufikelela ezixhobeni kuphela, kokugqibayo imiphumela, kuxhasa ingxoxo yokuba iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika zakhe ulawulo oluququzelelweyo kwaye oludibeneyo, kungekhona umgaqo-nkqubo okhona kuphela ephepheni.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review proposes a two-part framework for generative AI and academic integrity in higher education
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo lwencwadi olupapashwe kwijenali ethi AI and Ethics, olubhalwe ngu-Batool Hendal no-Gobinda Chowdhury, luhlalutye iziphumo ezingamakhowudi 274 ezivela kuphando olukhoyo malunga ne-i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, luzihlela ngaphantsi kweemba ezintandathu, kuquka iingenelo neengozi zayo, ukungathembakali kwezixhobo zokufumanisa umbhalo we-i-AI, kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo nolawulo lwamaziko. Esuka kobu bungqina, ababhali bacebisa Uzinzo lweMfundo lokuLungelelanisa ne-i-AI evelisayo, olumiselwe kwiintsika ezimbini, ulawulo kunye nemiyalelo yesiseko ngelinye icala, kunye nemfundo noluvo ngenye icala, njengendlela esebenzayo yokwamkela i-AI evelisayo ngembopheleleko kunokuba kungaba kuphela kugadwa.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-i-AI evelisayo kufundiso, kuvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, olu zinzo lunikezela iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika indlela enendlela kunokuba kugadwe nje ngokuncike kufumaniseko, elwakhiwe kubungqina obuqokelelweyo kunokuba kube ngamava elikazi elinye.

AI and Ethics · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Mixed-methods study of 1,685 publications and 48 interviews finds generative AI is reshaping assessment, not just fuelling misconduct
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olusebenzisa iindlela ezixubeneyo olupapashwe kwijenali ethi SN Social Sciences, olubhalwe ngu-Florieza M. Mangubat no-Fernando N. Mangubat, ludibanisa uhlalutyo lwedata ye-bibliometriki yoshicilelo olungama-1,685 olubhaliswe nge-Scopus malunga nengqibelelo yezemfundo kunye novavanyo, kunye noovavanyo noobafundi kunye noothisha abangama-48 kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo kwisithili saseCebu, ePhilippines. Lufumanise ukuba ingqalelo yemfundo kule nkalo yenyuke kakhulu emva kowe-2022, ukuba abafundi basebenzisa i-AI evelisayo ukufunda nokwenza umsebenzi wezemfundo kodwa abaqinisekile ukuba yeyiphi indlela yokusebenzisa eyamkelekileyo, kunye nokuba oothisha baphendula ngokuphinda bayile uvavanyo bahambise kumsebenzi oqinisekileyo kunye noqwalaselo lwenqubo, kunokuba baxhomekeke kuphela kuzixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-i-AI evelisayo kufundiso, kuvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba amaziko kwindawo eyenye yoMzantsi weHlabathi asuka ekugadeni aye ekuphindeni ayile uvavanyo kuhambelana noko iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika zisele zikucingela, kwaye kuyomeleza umbono wokuba ukuguqulwa koluvavanyo yimpendulo eyohlala ithembekile kunokufumaniseko nje.

SN Social Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 463 studies finds AI in Global South universities still mostly administrative, not pedagogical
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo kunye noluhlalutyo lwedata ye-bibliometriki olupapashwe kwijenali ethi Frontiers in Education, olubhalwe ngu-Nomfundo Gladys Khoza no-Freda van der Walt baseCentral University of Technology, eFree State, eMzantsi Afrika, luhlolile iirekhodi ezingama-947 kwaye lubandakanya uphononongo olungama-463 oluhlolwe ziingcali, olupapashwe phakathi kowe-2019 nowe-2025, malunga nokufundisa okuqinisiweyo yi-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo kwelizwe loMzantsi weHlabathi. Lufumanise ukuba uninzi lokusetyenziswa kwe-AI lusenokugxininisa kumsebenzi onobuchule kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo, ukuba udibaniso lwemfundiso lwenyani lusesincinci, kwaye ukuba ingqalasizinda engenelo, ukungalingani kokufikelela kwizixhobo zedijitali, ukungalungiselelwa ngokwaneleyo kootitshala kunye noxinezeleko lwemigaqo yokuziphatha zizona zithintelo ziphambili, ngelixa iisisombululo ezidibeneyo nendawo kunye nonqubo-lutsha lentsebenziswano ziyiwo amathuba acacileyo kunayo nayiphi na.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-i-AI evelisayo kufundiso kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo we-AI onembopheleleko kunye nolinganiselo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba ukusetyenziswa kolawulo kusahlula unqubo-lutsha lwenyani lwemfundiso ngaphaya koMzantsi weHlabathi lukhumbuza iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika, kuquka iWits, ukuba kufuneka zitya imali ngabom kukulungiselela kootitshala kunye nokufundisa okudibeneyo nendawo, kungabi kuphela kufikelelo kuzixhobo ze-AI.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article (systematic review)

entry.title: US universities race to launch AI majors as the count passes 100, nearly double in a year
entry.summary:
Iiyunivesithi ezingaphezu kwe-100 zaseMelika ngoku zinikezela ngesidanga sokuqala kwi-AI ngaphakathi kwamasebe ezobunzululwazi benjineli yekhompyutha, okumalunga nokuphindwe kabini kunonyaka owodwa odluleleyo, ngokutsho kwesiseko sedata esigcinwa liziko le-Center for Inclusive Computing kwiYunivesithi yaseNortheastern. Isidanga se-AI seYunivesithi yaseBentley sikhule ukusuka kubafundi abambalwa ekuqaleni kwaso ngo-2024 ukuya kufikelela ekubeni mazi-100 kulo nyaka, ngelixa isidanga seMIT se-AI and Decision Making, esaqalwa ngo-2022, singesidanga sesibini esithandwa kakhulu kwiyunivesithi, nabafundi abangama-354 ababhalisileyo. Abaphathi badibanisa oku kungxama kokungonwabi kwabafundi ngemveliso yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI, kwaye kunyanzelo lwabaqeshi lokufuna abaphumelele izidanga abanobuchule be-AI; uphando lwenziwa ngoMeyi lufumanise ukuba sinye kuphela kwiziko-zezi-66 eziphenduliweyo zinikezela ngesidanga se-AI ezifuna isifundo sokuziphatha.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD ngokubhekiselele kwi-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, ubungakanani kunye nesantya sotshintsho oku emntla weHlabathi, kunye nemfuneko engalinganiyo yoqeqesho lokuziphatha olunamkelwayo nalo, ngomlinganiselo iWits AHEAD enganokuwusebenzisa ukucinga indlela iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika ezinakho ukuyila izidanga ze-AI ezifanayo, ngendlela enembopheleleko kunokuba isabela nje.

WBUR · Public radio news report

entry.title: Study combines AI-TPACK and Freire's critical pedagogy to rethink AI in African STEM curricula
entry.summary:
Abaphandi ababini baseYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika (UNISA) babeka uphiko lwengcamango lokufaka i-AI kwikharityhulam ye-STEM kwilizwekazi laseAfrika, badibanisa imodeli ye-AI-TPACK kunye nendlela yokufundisa ebukhali kaPaulo Freire. Bexhomekeke kuphononongo lweencwadi kunokwenza uphando lwezenzo, iphepha liphonononga izixhobo ezifana nemiqulu yokufundisa ekrelekrele, iiplatform zokufunda eziguquguqukayo, kunye noviwo olwenziwa ngomatshini, lixele ukuba izinto ezi zinganceda ukunciphisa uxinzelelo kwiklasi ezigcwele kwaye ezinqabileyo kwizixhobo. Liphakamisa amacebo ahambelana nenkcubeko kwaye asekwe kumgaqo-nkqubo wokuziphatha, ajongana nendlala yeziseko zophuhliso, isakhono sootitshala kunye nokwahlukana kweemeko, ukwenzela ukuba ukwamkelwa kwe-AI akungxwelerhi ukungalingani okukhoyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD ngokubhekiselele kwi-AI kunye nohlalutyo lwedata kwi-STEM nemfundo yootitshala, iphepha eli lithi linike uphiko oluphicothayo, olusekelwe eAfrika, lokuvavanya izithembiso ze-AI kufundiso ye-STEM ngokumelene nokungenelela kwenyani kwilizwekazi ngokubhekiselele kwiziseko zophuhliso kunye nesakhono sootitshala, isilumkiso esifanele sithintele ukungxamiseka kokwamkelwa kwe-AI.

Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education (University of South Africa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Survey finds most Built Environment students use AI chatbots but African universities still lack formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Uphando lwabafundi be-Built Environment, olwaziswayo kwiNdibano ye-FIG ka-2026 eKapa, lufumanise ukuba ipesenti ezingama-74 zisebenzisa izinkulumbukhulu ze-AI ngenxa yemfundo, kwaye zineembono eziphuhlileyo ngazo, kodwa zithi zifumana ukhokelo oluncinane lweziko. Ababhali, ababhala besuka eNamibia naseNigeria, baphawula ukuba izikolo nje ezimbalwa zoMzantsi Afrika, kubandakanywa iWits, iYunivesithi yeKapa, iYunivesithi yePitoli neYunivesithi yaseJohannesburg, ziye zenze imigaqo ye-AI ukususela ngo-2024, ngelixa iipesenti ezingama-70 kwiiyunivesithi zeMelika zinemigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI ebhaliweyo. Zibeka icebo lohambo lokokuba iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika zakhe ulawulo lwe-AI olufanelekileyo kwimeko yazo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yeWits AHEAD yokuba i-AI ibe nembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba amaziko amaninzi aseAfrika awanamigaqo ye-AI esebenzayo, nangona abafundi basebenzisa izinkulumbukhulu ze-AI ngobuninzi, kubonisa ukuba ulawulo lusemva kakhulu kunokwenzeka; icebo lohambo elikweliphepha linika indawo yokuqala yokuvala lo msantsa.

FIG Congress 2026 (International Federation of Surveyors), Cape Town · Conference paper (International Federation of Surveyors)

entry.title: WISE and Education Collaborative partner with five African universities on an AI adoption pilot
entry.summary:
I-WISE (i-World Innovation Summit for Education) kunye ne-Education Collaborative yase-Ashesi University baqalise iprojekthi yovavanyo lokusetyenziswa kwe-AI kunye neeyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseAfrika: i-Bells University of Technology eNigeria, i-Botho University eBotswana, i-KCA University eKenya, i-University of Kigali eRwanda, kunye neUniversité d'Abomey-Calavi eBenin. Ukusukela ngo-Okthobha 2026 ukuya kuJuni 2027, iyunivesithi nganye iza kuvavanya iprojekthi efanelekileyo ngokweemfuno zayo, kususela koonontlalontle be-AI ehambelana nekharityhulumu kunye nezixhobo zokufunda ezizinzileyo, ukuya kwiinkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye nezikhokelo zolawulo lwemibutho. Luvavanyo luxhomekeke kuphononongo lwesiseko lwango-2025 olwenziwa kuma-47 eeyunivesithi zaseAfrika, olwafumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI akuzinzile kananjalo ulawulo lusesezantsi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi ka-Wits AHEAD ngolawulo olunembeko lwe-AI, luvavanyo olunqabileyo lwamazwe amaninzi oluvavanya izixhobo ze-AI kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo wemibutho ngaxeshanye kwiiyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseAfrika ezahluke ngokupheleleyo, lunika ubungqina bokuqala bothelekiso ngendlela ukusetyenziswa olunembeko olubonakala ngayo ngokwenyani.

africa.com (WISE and The Education Collaborative, Ashesi University) · International education initiative announcement

entry.title: Early success indicators at a South African university: a data-centric approach to student success
entry.summary:
UPhilokuhle Majozi noKgadi Mathabathe base-University of Pretoria baphakamise uhlaka "lwezibonakaliso zempumelelo yokuqala" oludibanisa iindawo zedatha kunye namanyathelo enkxaso ngesigaba sonke sobomi bomfundi, kususela ngaphambi kobhaliso ukusa kuvavanyo lwekamva. Ngokuxhomekeke kudliwanondlebe nabaqeqeshi bempumelelo yemfundo, iinkokeli zeziko kunye nazobunzululwazi bedatha, uhlaka olu lukhetha indlela esekelwe emandleni, enamandla wokuqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo, kunokuba kube ngamanqaku okulumkisa kwangethuba agxile kubuthathaka athetha ngokuba abafundi "basemngciphekweni."

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kunika intsika yoWits AHEAD yohlalutyo oluqikelelayo ikhetho lasemzantsi Afrika, elisekelwe emandleni, esikhundleni sezinto zemveliso zokulumkisa kwangethuba eziqhelekileyo, nto leyo ebalulekileyo kakhulu ekuyileni amanyathelo okugcina abafundi asekelayo kunokuba aphawule nje abafundi abajongene nobunzima.

Journal of Student Affairs in Africa · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Cambridge-led OpRaise report: AI markers favour style over substance in university essays
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bevela kwiiYunivesithi zeCambridge, Manchester Metropolitan neNottingham baphonononga iimodeli ezintathu eziphambili ze-AI, ngazinye kwaye zidibene, kwizincoko 761 zesaikholoji zabafundi bomnyaka wokuqala ezivela kwiiyunivesithi ezintathu zeUK. Iimodeli ezi zazivumelana ngokupheleleyo phakathi kwazo, kodwa zivumelana kancinci kakhulu nabavavanyi abangabantu, zihlala zinika amanqaku aphezulu kubhalo olude kwaye olunzulu, kungakhathaliseki ukufaneleka kwemfundo, kwaye amanqaku ebuthelelana embindini wesikali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ngoxa i-Wits AHEAD icinga indima ye-AI kuvavanyo, lo phando oluqinileyo oluvela kwiziko ngeziko lubonisa ukuba uphawulo oluzenzekelayo lusenika amandla indlela yokubhala kunokuqulathwe, oku kungumlumkiso ngokuchasene nokubeka i-AI esikhundleni sokugweba komntu kwiiyunivesithi zoMzantsi weHlabathi, apho amaklasi makhulu ngakumbi kwaye abavavanyi bambalwa.

University of Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Nottingham (OpRaise project) · University research report

entry.title: World Bank video: Korea Partnership Facility forum explores AI for education and skills
entry.summary:
Ikhanali yeYouTube yeWorld Bank Group ipapashe ividiyo emfutshane malunga nenkomfa yalo nyaka ye-Korea-World Bank Group Partnership Facility, apho amagosa evela kwisebe lezoqoqosho namaxhoba zemali yaseKorea, iingcali zeWorld Bank kunye nonjingalwazi we-KAIST baxubushe indlela i-AI enganokomeleza ngayo ukufunda kwaye ilungiselele abantu imisebenzi yexesha elizayo. I-Facility ixhasa iinkqubo ze-AI nezakhono zedijithali kwiinkqubo zemfundo nemisebenzi kumazwe asakhasayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 4, oku kubonisa ukuba amaziko emali ehlabathi ngoku ajonga uqeqesho lwezakhono ze-AI njengokubalulekileyo kuqesheko lwabaphumelele izidanga kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, kungekhona okongezelelweyo.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Study finds South African universities' AI policies strong on student rules, thin on privacy and staff duties
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluphononongayo iimigaqo ye-AI evelisayo epapashwe ziiyunivesithi karhulumente zoMzantsi Afrika lufumanise ukuba ama-46% kuphela eeziko afumana umgaqo-nkqubo wesiko liphela ngexesha lohlalutyo. Apho iimigaqo zazikhona, zazibeka imigaqo echazwe kakuhle malunga nokucacileko kunye noxanduva lwabafundi, kodwa zaphatha ubuyele, ulawulo lwedatha kunye noxanduva lwabasebenzi kafutshane, ikakhulu njengecebiso kungekhona imigaqo enyanzelekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 6, lobu bungqina obuthe ngqo kwi-Wits AHEAD: ababhali bafuna imigaqo evunyelweyo, eyilwe kwasekuqaleni ukukhusela ubuyele, oko kona kukhona isikroba solawulo lwe-AI olunoxanduva eli qela eliluhlalutya.

Universal Access in the Information Society · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Smartphone AI tools help STEM teachers in low-resource African classrooms move beyond chalk and talk, study finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwemeko oluphathwe yi-Universiti Sains Malaysia lusebenzisane noothisha be-STEM abalishumi baseNigeria, Botswana, Ghana, Namibia naseSierra Leone kwindlu yomsebenzi yesandla esisebenzisa iintonga ze-AI eziguqula izwi libe ngumfanekiso, ukubhala ikhowudi ngeeblokhi kwifowuni, kunye nokulingiswa kweesekethe zombane. Ootitshala bathi izixhobo ezi zenze kube lula ukubonisa izinto zenzululwazi ezinzima ukucacisa, zavumela abafundi abangenazo iikhompyutha eziphathwayo ukwakha izakhono zokubhala ikhowudi kwifowuni, zaza zabavumela ukuvavanya iisekethe ngokukhuselekileyo ngaphambi kokuchukumisa izixhobo zenyani ezinqabileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 3, lobu bungqina obuhle bokuba izixhobo ze-AI ezikhethwe ngononophelo kwaye zingabizi, kungekhona izixhobo ezibiza kakhulu, ziyazo ezinganokutshintsha ukufundiswa kwe-STEM kwiindlu zefundo zaseAfrika ezinqabileyo ngezixhobo ukusuka kufundiso yelekicha ukuya kuphononongo lwenyani.

ECNU Review of Education · Peer-reviewed journal article
